faqs.q: How much does a 7-day Vietnam golf holiday cost per person?
faqs.a: A premium 7-day Vietnam golf holiday including 4 rounds at top Da Nang courses, private villa accommodation (shared between 4), private transfers, and most meals typically costs AUD $4,500–6,500 per person when booked through AGS. This compares favourably with equivalent golf experiences in Japan (AUD $7,000+) or the UK (AUD $6,000+).

faqs.q: What are green fees at Vietnam's top golf courses?
faqs.a: Green fees at Vietnam's premier courses (Hoiana Shores, Ba Na Hills, BRG) range from USD $110–160 per round. Mid-tier courses (Montgomerie Links, Vinpearl Golf) run USD $70–110. All green fees include mandatory caddie service at premium venues. AGS negotiates preferred rates as a volume operator.

faqs.q: Is a private villa cheaper than a hotel in Da Nang?
faqs.a: For groups of 4–6, a private villa is typically cheaper per person than equivalent hotel accommodation — and delivers significantly more privacy, a private pool, and villa staff. AGS's An Bang villa portfolio runs AUD $250–500 per villa per night (split between the group), versus AUD $200–350 per room at comparable five-star properties.

faqs.q: Are caddies included in Vietnam golf green fees?
faqs.a: Yes — caddie fees are included in the green fee at all premium Vietnam courses. Tips are discretionary (typically USD $10–20 per round per caddie) and are not included in AGS package pricing. We encourage tipping for exceptional caddie service.

faqs.q: Does AGS charge a booking fee?
faqs.a: AGS charges a service fee as part of our all-inclusive package pricing. This covers tee time procurement and coordination, private transfer management, villa/accommodation sourcing and booking, 24/7 on-ground support, and personalised itinerary design. We do not itemise this separately — our pricing reflects the total cost of a fully managed experience.

  • The total cost, including return flights from Sydney (AUD $900–1,400), ranges from AUD $3,100–4,870 per person for the 2026 package.
  • Key cost components per person include AUD $700–1,000 for 7 nights' villa accommodation, AUD $750–1,100 for green fees at four top Da Nang courses, and AUD $200–350 for private transfers.

How AGS Pricing Works

Asia Golf Specialists packages the in-country components (accommodation, golf, transfers, selected dining and experiences) into a single, transparent total. Flights and personal spending are excluded — we help you identify optimal flight options but don't book them on your behalf.

Our pricing is fixed from the moment of booking — we don't charge per-person supplements, single-supplement fees, or add hidden gratuity charges. What we quote is what you pay, in full, before departure.

The Value Comparison

For context: a comparable 7-day golf trip to Japan (Hakone, Fujizakura) runs AUD $6,000–8,000 per person excluding flights. Scottish links golf (St Andrews, Carnoustie) typically costs AUD $7,000–10,000 per person. A Da Nang circuit at AUD $3,000–5,000 all-in from Sydney represents exceptional value for course quality that is genuinely comparable at the top tier.
